## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/hooks/test-post-functions-attribution.sh exists
  Verify: test -f tests/hooks/test-post-functions-attribution.sh
- [ ] test_hook_record_agent_attribution_writes_jsonl_entry_when_enabled function present
  Verify: grep -q 'test_hook_record_agent_attribution_writes_jsonl_entry_when_enabled' tests/hooks/test-post-functions-attribution.sh
- [ ] test_hook_record_agent_attribution_skips_write_when_disabled function present
  Verify: grep -q 'test_hook_record_agent_attribution_skips_write_when_disabled' tests/hooks/test-post-functions-attribution.sh
- [ ] Tests run in fresh subshells (due to _POST_FUNCTIONS_LOADED=1 guard)
  Verify: grep -q 'bash.*test_hook_record\|(\s*test_hook_record' tests/hooks/test-post-functions-attribution.sh
- [ ] Tests are RED (fail) before T1b-impl is implemented
